policies.sweep20: at original monthly signal close cap each equity_crisis/gold book share at20%; no loss replenishment; remainder reserve
policies.cap40: at original monthly signal close cap each equity_crisis/gold book share at40%; no loss replenishment; remainder reserve
policies.active20: monthly closed source target contains positive non-BIL weight =>20% book share, otherwise zero; remainder reserve; explicit recapitalization when active
policies.scope: shares frozen at original monthly closed decision and filled after original delay; continuous cap not claimed; original source target stream unchanged; gross per-book fees including opposite fills
policies.profit: capital transfers sum zero and excluded from profit; three initial shares20/20/60; no new yield sources

dsr_pbo: not calculated; global trial count unreconciled; history consumed

selection_policy.primary: maximize minimum cash_excess_sharpe across all four cost/delay cells
selection_policy.ties: minimum CAGR, worst drawdown, lower maximum turnover, stable version ID

inverse_ETF_model: SH/PSQ/TBF actual adjusted open/close prices; long units of daily inverse funds, including embedded expenses and daily compounding; no synthetic minus-index returns
previously_consumed_later_data: Fifth-round July31..Sep30 equity and September crypto observations already inspected; no new independent later check in this round
missing_asset_policy: All ETH/PAXG segments resolved by decision-day available full history; never choose a latest future segment or fill gaps
fundamental_scope: No new source cashflow or fundamental claim; no funding, short, margin, borrowing or manufactured cash yield. Existing public sources remain frozen; forward windows not read.
stop_policy: One frozen study,8 new candidates/11 controls/76 curves; preserve every result; no return-conditioned rescue.
structural_question: Merge source and closed risk budgets into one funded book execution; separate family refresh from coupled recovery.
accounting: Actual spot/fund units, owned vintage reductions and same-book BIL financing; gross independent book fees, no internal crossing discount; capital transfers sum zero and are not profit.

g20.decision: same closed source targets/scopes and monthly sweep20/cap40 shares; after each close merge feasible source changes with held complementary non-BIL weights; cap projected investment dollars per book/global NAV at20%/40%
g20.settlement: one dated target and scope per book; binding budget expands to full-book target with funded BIL remainder; original T+1/T+2; no separate cap order/epoch cancellation or round-trip fee paths
g20.qualification: binding daily targets are full source-book rebalances and may buy risk units at fill; same-book cash funding and actual gross fees; no continuous hard exposure or derivative look-through claim; monthly capital transfers remain zero-sum

c60.core_week: Sunday refresh acquires core only; satellite transitions/refills acquire satellites; any core transition/refill retains coupled full fill
c60.sat_week: Sunday refresh acquires satellites only; satellite transitions/refills acquire satellites; any core transition/refill retains coupled full fill
c60.split_week: Sunday core and Wednesday satellite refresh; satellite transitions/refills scoped; any core transition/refill retains coupled full fill
c60.split_local: Sunday core and Wednesday satellite refresh; all recovery/refill triggers acquire their own family, simultaneous triggers union both; no coupled core override
c60.common: original zero/absent nominal to positive, half recovered targets outside Sunday and next-close refill; scheduled acquisitions union scoped recovery; complement uses owned-vintage reductions and nominal-zero exits; latest-closed-zero acquisition cancellation; 60-day60% covariance cap over combined planned weights and shared cash, not actual hard volatility ceiling

failed_initial_run.reason: second pre-start delayed instruction falsely declared monthly capital reset
